items.title: 1.1  Template authoring status
items.discussion: All twelve templates are authored. Two required rework after the accessibility review; both are now passing. No further authoring work is expected this phase.

items.title: 1.2  Container font licensing
items.discussion: The Microsoft core fonts package is required for faithful Office-to-PDF conversion. Legal are reviewing redistribution terms for the container image and will report back in week 32.

items.title: 1.3  Release readiness
items.discussion: Staging has been stable for eleven days. The group agreed to hold the production date and add reviewer capacity rather than reduce the accessibility scope.

decisions.rationale: Slippage is recoverable with additional review capacity.

decisions.decision: Add 0.4 FTE to the accessibility workstream
decisions.rationale: Cheaper than a delayed release; funded from the phase contingency.

actions.action: Confirm font redistribution terms for the container
